summary: Owner is outside FCC jurisdiction; his SAR group has used marine VHF on these radios for years, so the amateur-band-lock hypothesis is likely wrong (many RT-950 Pro units transmit 136-174/400-520 MHz). Cause reopened: a NewChirp write effect is plausible. The 144-148/420-450 NEWCHIRP_TX_BANDS warning (8a815371) is unverified and must be checked against the Pro CPS or corrected before 1.0.64. Owner plans to reprogram with Radtel CPS: asked for a NewChirp read before and after as a comparison pair.
